verdict.rationale: Docs show a single call (getSandbox()) creates or reconnects to an isolated VM/container sandbox with immediate access to exec, file, and session APIs (docs-37, docs-38, docs-50), and community discussion corroborates boot times in the 1-5 second range consistent with 'seconds' provisioning (comm-1, comm-8). Missing for 10: an independent benchmark or first-party latency SLA confirming consistent sub-few-second cold starts across load, since community notes it's slower than some Firecracker-based competitors.
